cohort: The study included 42 individuals with KBG syndrome.
finding: Individuals with KBG syndrome showed higher rates of several perinatal complications, including C-section, congenital heart defects, prematurity, NICU admission, small for gestational age, and family history of miscarriage, compared to the overall population.
mod_finding: 45.2% of the cohort with KBG syndrome was born by C-section, a rate noted as higher than the overall population.
